faq.a: $5.00 Per Game/Per Person, plus $3.00 Shoe Rental/Per Person.

faq.q: Can I host a party at Shooters Pub?
faq.a: Yes. Reserved space inside or out, access to pool, darts, shuffleboard, cornhole & TVs, full bar, outdoor beer garden (seasonal). No rental fee with food and drink purchase. Custom catering packages available.
Pizzas, party subs, taco bars, grilled favorites, and more. Available for events at Shooters & Exeter Bowling Lanes. Get in touch to start planning.
